name: muography-deployment-evaluation
description: Static muography deployment evaluation app; layered test commands per docs/specs/TEST_STRATEGY.md. No runtime dependencies.

scripts.test:data: node --test "tests/data/*.test.mjs" && node scripts/check-geometry-conformance.mjs --dataset zhouning-lower-reservoir-dam@0.6.2+schema0.7.0 --backend compiled > /dev/null && node scripts/check-semantic-mapping.mjs > /dev/null && python3 scripts/check-dataset-release.py
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:data && npm run test:integration && npm run test:browser
